items.summary: In a move that has sent shockwaves through sports fans across the world, LeBron James has officially signed with the Philadelphia 76ers. items.title: Are we sure Philadelphia is the ideal spot for LeBron James?
items.summary: When LeBron James puts on his Philadelphia 76ers jersey for the first time in a couple months, he will be getting close to his 42nd birthday. And his age will be the least weird thing about it.The long-awaited announcement that came Friday — a "last decision," he called it on social media — makes sense if you follow how James' mind has worked throughout his career but also feels oddly out of place.A third and final stint in Cleveland would have closed a circle that began at birth. Finishing in Miami would have put a bow on arguably the most interesting and controversial chapter of his career.But perhaps more than any other all-time great in the history of team sports, James' decisions have been driven less by narrative or legacy than what he perceives to be in his immediate interests.
